items.topic: backend authority / consequential writes / testing / deployment
items.reviewer: AETHER / AG-006 then SENTINEL / AG-008; MENTOR / AG-012 only after reproducible pass
items.measurableNextStep: Extend the existing staging-only consequential-write experiment rather than create a new Agent: client sends intent only; server validates schema, identity/permission and authoritative state; test tampered client values, unauthorized writes, duplicate/replay and external-side-effect failure/reconciliation. Require deterministic tests and audit evidence before skill promotion.
items.outcome: SOURCE CLAIM: MilerDev's creator-owned stack page says API routes validate input and permissions server-side, pricing is calculated from database state, payment/access state is persisted in MySQL, and pull requests pass lint/typecheck/automated/browser tests before merge. INFERENCE: this externally corroborates the direction of existing SIG-003 but does not validate AGIS implementation. UNKNOWN: whether the pattern improves AGIS defect rate, time-to-value, ROI or revenue until internal staging evidence exists.
